newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi, United airlines in passenger deal.
newsitem.headline: Saudi, United airlines in passenger deal.

text.p: Saudi Arabian Airlines Corp said it had reached a marketing agreement with UAL Corp's United Airlines which would come into effect on February 18.
The agreement launched "a marketing cooperation programme between the two carriers covering the Jeddah/New York/Los Angeles route", Saudi Arabian Airlines Corp said in a statement
Passengers of Saudi Arabian's twice-weekly, Jeddah-New York flights would now be able to check through to Los Angeles.
Passengers leaving Los Angeles for Jeddah would similarly be issued with boarding passes checking them through New York and on to Jeddah.
"Both airlines have implemented close cooperation covering ground, technical and reservation services to make this facility possible," the statement said.

Hany Aref, Saudi Arabian Airlines vice president, Arab and international affairs, said future plans "could include extending this type of SV/UA block space agreement to other destinations, developing an even closer joint relationship".
